A has plumper gloves, simpler large lace motifs and chunkier bows; B's lace is finer and more see-through, and its thinner ribbons look busier.
A's feather and bottle are larger and chunkier, with smooth broad lobes, closer to the bold real cards; B's feather is slimmer and more finely grooved.
A's feather has broad smooth lobes; B's feather is etched with fine barb lines that lean too texture-y.
A keeps the feather in smooth, chunky sculpted lobes like the real cards' finish; B adds fine striations.
A's feather is fuller and simpler and its bottle sits big in the frame; B's feather has more fine line detail and the object is smaller.
